title: autoresearch: two loops through four layers
subtitle: The outer loop runs left to right, one round after another; the shaded inner loop runs once per experiment, several at a time. Red borders: points that can refuse. Generated from architecture.json; archdraw.py check keeps it in step with the code.

spans.label: inner loop: once per experiment, several in parallel (GPU slots)

file.label: plain file in the problem folder

nodes.label:
Prompt; approves
the problem
nodes.note: the person starts a round with a prompt (the filled loop prompt: stop time, permissions) and approves the problem the planner drafted

nodes.label:
Promotion: OK
and TEST once
nodes.note: the person's: a version becomes the deployed champion only with their OK and one TEST check, logged before it runs (run.py refuses otherwise)

nodes.label:
Planner
problem draft
nodes.note: the planner in mode problem drafts changes of PROBLEM.md from the prompt; the file stays protected, the person approves

nodes.label:
Researcher
scouts, summaries
nodes.note: only on a trigger (METHOD.md, Planning a round): scouts in parallel, one per topic, then a summary with its digest per problem group

nodes.label:
Planner: branches
(one per lens); critic
nodes.note: the planner writes cards once per lens, in parallel; the critic (fresh context) accepts, revises or rejects each card

nodes.label:
Planner, coder
+ critic
nodes.note: only for a block experiment (new code): detail plan naming the boxes it changes, code with its spec test, a critic pass on shared code; a variant needs no agent; prompts/experiment_flow.md is one experiment in six steps (plan card, coding, experiment, training, evaluation, store to the result folder)

nodes.label:
Planner: tracking
n best, next round
nodes.note: reads the verdicts, updates the set of n best by the written rule, proposes a promotion, plans the next branches

nodes.label:
Critic
numbers of the report
nodes.note: a fresh reviewer checks the round's report against the primary sources

nodes.label: WRITE GATE: protected truth files only with a grant under a decided D<n>; a card only when complete (G2)

experiments/E<id>/
experiment.md (card block)
nodes.note: the round's plan (PLAN.md); each card names the version it starts from and its decision rule; the card block of experiment.md is what decide.py reads

nodes.label:
run records
run.json, log.jsonl
nodes.note: written by the launcher and the training; read by the train suite

nodes.label:
the n best versions
registry, champion
nodes.note: the problem's list of good versions: lane models/registry.json (several named systems), bev_fusion records/champion.json (base, options); the tracking planner updates it, promotion stays the person's

nodes.label:
START GATE
card, slot, tag
nodes.note: run.py starts a run only with a card (hypothesis, prediction, rule), a free GPU slot, no other owner's exclusive machine lock (D19), the TEST split only with a logged row; it tags the code it ran

nodes.label:
the problem's
literature tools
nodes.note: no code in autoresearch/ yet; the lane problem's catalogue would move up once a second problem uses it

nodes.label:
launcher + train
suite, kill rules
nodes.note: a training is watched by code: the card's kill rules stop it (`watch --enforce`), `trainsuite early` only advises from the learning curves; an alarm wakes the lead chat, no agent watches; `trainsuite start` composes and launches, `trainsuite queue` shows the GPU slots and the line of waiting runs; the loop that is watched is the engine below

nodes.label:
training engine
trainkit: fit loop
nodes.note: D48: the project-independent training loop (accumulation, EMA, learning-rate schedule per module, clipping, non-finite skip, AMP, atomic checkpoints with resume, the stop request); a project supplies model, loss, data and config (contract in trainkit/README.md); it writes log.jsonl, checkpoints and STOPPED, reads CONTROL, so the trainsuite and run.py need no project code; the BEV trainer bev_fusion/training/train.py is its first user, a run trains from a pinned copy in runs/<id>/code

nodes.label:
eval suite (VAL)
decide.py: the rule
nodes.note: numbers, pictures and ms on VAL; decide.py turns the cards into KEEP / CUT / TIE / INCONCLUSIVE by the card's written rule; package.py writes the result package of a run (with the scene lists in split.json) and cleans derived data

nodes.label:
board, prototype
(per problem)
nodes.note: tools/keep3.py keeps the best three networks complete (one slot per checkpoint, per arm with its seeds in bev_fusion; the records are the keep3.json of each problem); the deployment suite: each problem's prototype command runs a version on chosen frames, writes planner-ready outputs and copies the numbers of its metric card and the ms per frame of its timing record (bev_fusion: evaluation/bev_prototype.py); a shared tool only when a third problem needs one

nodes.label:
cleanup, checks
clean_temp, archdraw
nodes.note: tags the scratch and moves temp/ away, finds dead paths, checks the report's numbers, the per-round table, these drawings; commit_paths.py commits exactly the named paths of a unit of work (scratch and forbidden files refused)

groups.label: AGENTS: four roles, run by the lead chat
FILES in the problem folder: the only contract between the layers
